card.title: Effortlessly Unbelievable
card.instruction: Be sincerely impressed by how naturally someone inhabits the strange reality, then compete to appear even less surprised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You asked that talking doorway for directions without hesitating. That's impressive. I usually just chat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then ask it where the toilets are. We're late.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Through its ear. Give me a minute; I've never gone in that way.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Left ear or right, door? You take your minute. I'll save you a cubicle.

mechanism: A admires B's ease with a talking door, then uses B's hesitation at ear entry to demonstrate even greater nonchalance.
confusable: Unlike trying merely to hide outsider confusion, A explicitly compares naturalness with B and seeks to surpass it.
comparison: The doorway alternative exploits B's pause to proceed first; the invisible-guest alternative outdoes B's careful hospitality by granting unrestricted access.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
